# Capacity Connect

> Capacity Connect is a skill-training and certification platform connecting
> trainees, trainers, and administrators. Trainees browse courses, complete
> lessons and quizzes, track progress, and earn certificates. Trainers create
> and manage courses, monitor student progress, and view analytics.
> Administrators oversee users, courses, and platform-wide analytics.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing the platform and its three user roles
  (trainee, trainer, administrator).
- [Login](/login): Sign in for existing trainees, trainers, and admins.
- [Register](/register): Create a new trainee or trainer account.

## Notes for automated agents

- Dashboard areas (/trainee/*, /trainer/*, /admin/*) require authentication
  and are not publicly indexable content — see /robots.txt.
- This site does not permit automated account creation, scraping of learner
  data, or bulk downloading of course content.
